title: Flat Troll Blue 3-Inch Solid Brass Cabinet Pull - Traditional Cabinet-Mount Handle (3.9 In L X 1.6 In H X 0.9 In W, 1 In Projection), Allied Brass
body_html:
Finished in Flat Troll Blue, refresh cabinets and drawers with a traditional look that feels substantial in the hand—

  • Flat Troll Blue creates a distinctive focal point
  • Choose from 28 designer finishes to match the rest of your space
  • Count on solid brass construction that outlasts die-cast zinc alternatives
  • Get a clean install with included mounting hardware
  • Add a cohesive touch by coordinating with other Allied Brass pieces throughout your home

Specs
- Product type: Cabinet pull
- Mounting: Cabinet mount
- Material: Brass
- Style: Traditional
- Dimensions (L x H x W): 3.9 in x 1.6 in x 0.9 in
- Projection: 1 in
- Weight capacity: 2 lb
- Product weight: 0.8 lb
- Included: Cabinet pull and all installation hardware
- Assembly required: No
- Warranty: Limited lifetime warranty

Complete your space with coordinating hardware and accessories for a unified look, which presents a distinctive, muted blue-gray tone that adds artistic character to contemporary bathroom designs.
